name: PPN Masukan
query:
SELECT
    pi.supplier AS "Supplier:Link/Supplier:150",
    s.tax_id AS "Tax ID::100",
    pi.name AS "Invoice Name:Link/Purchase Invoice:150",
    pi.bill_no AS "Bill Number::150",
    pi.bill_date AS "Bill Date:Date:100",
    pi.total_taxes_and_charges AS "Total Taxes and Charges:Currency:150"
FROM
    `tabPurchase Invoice` pi
LEFT JOIN
    `tabSupplier` s ON pi.supplier = s.name
WHERE
    pi.docstatus = 1
ORDER BY
    pi.bill_date DESC
